description: This source file implements the core logic for merging Git notes, including functions for initializing options, analyzing diffs between notes, handling conflicts, and performing the merge process across commits and references.

methods.name: void init_notes_merge_options(struct repository * r,struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Initializes the notes merge options structure with default values and associates it with a given repository.

methods.name: int notes_merge(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * local_tree,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Performs a three-way merge of notes between a local and remote reference, creating a new merged notes commit object.

methods.name: int notes_merge_commit(struct notes_merge_options * o,struct notes_tree * partial_tree,struct commit * partial_commit,struct object_id * result_oid)
methods.description: Commits the merged notes from the notes merge worktree, creating a new commit with updated notes.

methods.name: int notes_merge_abort(struct notes_merge_options * o)
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing notes merge by removing all files in the notes merge worktree.
